items.name: base
items.title: Ledger base
items.description: Ledger design tokens, the Tailwind theme and the type utilities. Use when installing any Ledger component — everything depends on it.
items.author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
items.docs: Import the Ledger theme once at the top of your global stylesheet: `@import "@ledger/tokens/theme.css";` — or copy the tokens in directly. Ledger sets font-variant-numeric on every figure; do not override it, and never set a figure in the sans inside a table.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A pill button in four tones and three sizes. Use when the user takes an action; solid is the one primary action per view.
items.author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
items.docs: Exactly one `tone="solid"` button per view. Use `quiet` for the action beside it, `ghost` for tertiary, and `danger` only for destructive actions.

ledger.purpose: The one pressable shape in the system.
dontUseWhen: selecting from a set of options

insteadUse.navigating between pages: a link styled with buttonVariants via asChild

ledger.antiExampleWhy: Stock Tailwind palette colours are not Ledger tokens, the radius is not the pill the system uses, and "Submit" is not a plain verb naming what will happen.
